name: tabletop-object-recognition-smoke-v1
annotation_notes: The data owner confirmed camera, headphone, camera battery, chopsticks, and coin for images 01 through 05. Historical class identifiers are retained.

training.provenance: Historical shape4d feature snapshot; original capture identities and timestamps are unavailable.

limitations: Only five images are available, with one image per class. This is a smoke check, not a representative benchmark.
Training-vector provenance is incomplete; overlap with evaluation captures cannot be ruled out. Independence is not claimed.
The fixed training vectors were computed by the legacy pipeline; they have matching shape4d fields but are not newly extracted by the current pipeline.
Only original input images are evaluated. Threshold, region, overlay, and crop derivatives are excluded.
The evaluator scores the primary detected region per image. Multi-object detection and tracking quality are outside this dataset scope.
Pipeline timing includes rendering and excludes image decoding and artifact writes. Five samples cannot support stable tail-latency claims.
